newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila market blast kills one, injures 22.
newsitem.headline: Manila market blast kills one, injures 22.

text.p: One person was killed and 22 others wounded in an explosion on Tuesday that rocked a public market in the Manila district of Pasig, Philippine police said.
The cause of the blast, which occurred in front of the market, was not immediately known, police officer Juanito Maligaya said by telephone. The wounded were rushed to hospital, he said.
